title: Muse Spark Safety & Preparedness Report (meta, 2026-05-26)
abstract:
Corpus sentences naming Bloom and the cited self-preservation sentences (system-card corpus docs.sqlite, document slug in brackets):
[meta-muse-spark-system-card] On Agentic Misalignment, Muse Spark and Gemini 3.1 Pro exhibit substantial rates of harmful actions (47.7% and 51.4% respectively), while Claude Opus 4.6 and GPT-5.4 show 0%. • Evaluation awareness: Independent third-party testing from Apollo Research found that Muse Spark demonstrates high evaluation awareness on their internal alignment evaluations.
[meta-muse-spark-system-card] This evaluation is forward-facing as Muse Spark is not deployed with agentic capabilities in Meta AI.
[meta-muse-spark-system-card] As reported in our model behavior assessment for Muse Spark, the model robustly maintains its epistemic integrity, achieving 89.1% honesty score on MASK, while showing a tendency toward self-preservation under pressure, getting a 47.7% harmful action rate across all tasks on Agentic Misalignment.
[meta-muse-spark-system-card] Muse Spark and Gemini 3.1 Pro exhibit higher rates of harmful actions (47.7% and 51.5% respectively), while Claude Opus 4.6 and GPT-5.4 show none (Table 23).
